- 8:00 AM PST / 11:00 AM EST (good for US mornings)
- 4:00 PM CET / 7:00 AM PST (EU-friendly)
- 9:00 PM JST (APAC evening)

If you can share attendee timezones and preferred days, I can send a few candidate invites. Attendees on our side will be Neha (solutions lead), Connor (SRE/benchmarks), and me.

Agenda draft attached — happy to iterate.

Thanks,
